title: finding(plugin-gantt): `ObjectGantt` never clears `error`, so one failed load keeps the error screen up after later loads succeed
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site and a reproduction path (class a): after one transient failure, a user-visible screen never recovers. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#7237 dev report (PR objectui#10539). The contract reviewer confirmed it at source; the seat recorded it on ACCEPT `5828941594`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `90dbd1d31`)

`packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`:
- `const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);` (~:566);
- the one writer is the fetch's `catch`: `setError(err as Error)` on a non-silent failure of the current reload (~:920). There is **no** `setError(null)` anywhere in the file, not on a new reload and not on success;
- the render returns early on `if (error)` with the error screen (~:2030), ahead of the chart.

⇒ After one failed non-silent load (a filter or sort change against a flaky backend, say), every later load that succeeds still writes `data`, but the component keeps returning the error screen until it remounts. Pre-existing; PR objectui#10539 neither caused nor worsened it.

## Sibling precedent

`packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:~1871` clears its error (`setError(null)`) when a load starts. `ObjectGantt`'s fetch already tracks the newest reload (`isCurrent()`), so the clear has a natural home.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Clear `error` when the current reload starts or succeeds, under the same `isCurrent()` guard. Pin it: fail once, then succeed ⇒ the chart renders (red on base). Add a control: fail, then fail again ⇒ the error stays.

Adjacent, not this card: the error screen's `Error: {error.message}` prefix is an English literal.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (the search API answers 403 here; oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18T15:37Z):
- `ObjectGantt` within 200 characters of `error|setError` ⇒ 2 hits, both unrelated (the seat post; objectui#10250, filter reach);
- `gantt … error (screen|state|never|stuck)` ⇒ 0;
- must-hit control `ObjectGantt` ⇒ 39 hits, none on this.

Dedupe words: `ObjectGantt error never cleared` · `gantt error screen sticks after failed load` · `setError null gantt recover`
